outreach.subject: Quick thought on your Dentacare site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking over the Dentacare SM Manila site and really appreciate the clean, welcoming layout and easy booking setup you have for patients.

While browsing, I noticed a couple of minor things worth tightening up: some of your blog excerpts cut off mid-sentence (which can ding reader trust), and the site is missing local business markup that helps Google showcase your practice in local searches.

We put together a quick live demo showing how these fixes look in action. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

outreach.subject: Dobles Dental Clinic's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

It's impressive to see Dobles Dental Clinic's legacy caring for patients since 1953. 

I noticed you're currently relying entirely on Facebook rather than a dedicated website. While it's an active page, it limits your professional branding and makes it harder for new patients to easily book appointments or find you via Google. Plus, missing local search schema means you're likely losing out on nearby patients searching for oral surgery and implants.

We actually put together a quick, live demo of a clean, modern website tailored for your clinic. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
